description: The writer's fallback at a reference key or item position (rule 11): a create_case whose case_request_fields key is the literal "queue:front-desk", a get_case whose case_response_fields item is the literal "casetemplate:billing-dispute", and an update_case whose key is the literal "casefield:priority" each read as a reference key, so each action is written generic and its parameters round-trip as the literals they are; the system field id summary and item case_id beside them, and the create's casetemplate token, are carried in the generic parameters. Awaits the provider release whose refs key pattern knows casetemplate (tasks/D10), so it has no validate directory yet.
